name: Vinculatti

notes.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

items.name: Fearsense 60 feet
items.text: The vinculatti is aware of all frightened creatures within the listed range.

items.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Jingling Approach
items.text: When a creature rolls Perception for its initiative in combat against the vinculatti or succeeds at a Perception check against the vinculatti's Stealth DC, it must attempt a DC 27 Will save save. On a failure, it's Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

items.name: No Liberation
items.text:
Trigger A creature Grabbed or Restrained by the vinculatti attempts to Escape

---
Effect The triggering creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the check to Escape.

items.name: Master of Manacles
items.text: The vinculatti's manacles can grapple or restrain any number of creatures within the devil's reach. They can apply the nonlethal trait to Constrict when damaging foes Grabbed or Restrained by their manacles.

items.name: Prisoner Transfer
items.text:
Requirements A Large or smaller creature is Grabbed or Restrained by the vinculatti's mandibles

---
Effect The vinculatti moves the creature to their manacles, freeing their mandibles to make attacks, and then Constricts the creature it moved.

items.name: To the Cells
items.text: The vinculatti Strides or Climbs up to half their Speed, moving any creatures it has Grabbed or Restrained the same distance in that direction.

items.name: Whispers of Despair
items.text:
Requirements A creature is Grabbed or Restrained by the vinculatti

---
Effect The vinculatti taunts the creature about its captivity. The creature must attempt a DC 30 Will save save. On a failure, it becomes Frightened 2 (Frightened 3 on a critical failure). Regardless of the save's result, the target is temporarily immune to Whispers of Despair for 1 hour.

text: Warden devils exist to capture and imprison mortals, whether as jailers in Hell or hunters summoned by diabolists. Vinculattis exercise little discretion and show less interest in a prisoner's sentence or condition. Warden devils take cruel satisfaction in heaping psychological distress on their charges, enumerating the pleasures a prisoner is now denied.
